questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{解答}\quad&\text{方法一：}\quad\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 1}(x^{2}+4y^{2}+9)d\sigma=\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{1}(r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta+4r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta+9)rdr\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left[\frac{1}{4}r^{4}+\frac{3}{4}r^{4}\sin^{2}\theta+\frac{9}{2}r^{2}\right]_{0}^{1}d\theta=\int_{0}^{2\pi}(\frac{19}{4}+\frac{3}{4}\sin^{2}\theta)d\theta=\frac{41}{4}\pi.\text{⊝}\\&\text{方法二：}\quad\\&\quad\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 1}(x^{2}+4y^{2}+9)d\sigma=\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 1}(x^{2}+4y^{2})d\sigma+9\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 1}d\sigma\text{⊝}\\&=\frac{5}{2}\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 1}(x^{2}+y^{2})d\sigma+9\pi=\frac{5}{4}\pi+9\pi=\frac{41}{4}\pi.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4}(x^{2}+4y^{2}+9)d\sigma=\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{2}(r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta+4r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta+9)rdr\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left[\frac{1}{4}r^{4}+\frac{3}{4}r^{4}\sin^{2}\theta+\frac{9}{2}r^{2}\right]_{0}^{2}d\theta=\int_{0}^{2\pi}(22+12\sin^{2}\theta)d\theta=56\pi.\\&\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4}(x^{2}+4y^{2}+9)d\sigma=\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4}(x^{2}+4y^{2})d\sigma+9\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4}d\sigma\\&=\frac{5}{2}\iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4}(x^{2}+y^{2})d\sigma+36\pi=20\pi+36\pi=56\pi.\end{aligned}
